name: Summer Jobs at Crystal Springs Waterpark, East Brunswick
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at the Crystal Springs waterpark. You can be a lifeguard (training is given). Other jobs are lazy river attendant, guest relations, upkeep or slide tower dispatch.
who_can_apply: You must reach these ages by May 1 of the season. Lifeguards must be at least 15. Lazy river attendants must be at least 14. Guest relations, upkeep and slide tower dispatch must be at least 16. You do not need a lifeguard card to apply. Crystal Springs gives the training.
pay_detail: Pay rate not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 were posted with age cutoffs of May 1, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the apply links on the Crystal Springs summer employment page. Questions: crystalsprings@eastbrunswick.org or 732-390-6797.
notes: Lazy river attendant and guest relations spots were listed as limited or waitlist only. Applying does not guarantee a job.
